{"metadata":{"description":"在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页管理 MCP 服务器：运行时添加/编辑/启停/重连/删除，实时状态、自动重连，中英双语界面。MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness — add, edit, enable/disable, reconnect & delete MCP servers from the web settings page, with live status and auto-reconnect.","id":"gh:1333961384","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-mcp-manager","slug":"Nichts0v0/dsh-mcp-manager","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh","dsh-plugin","mcp"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页管理 MCP 服务器：运行时添加/编辑/启停/重连/删除，实时状态、自动重连，中英双语界面。MCP server manager for DeepSeek "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Harness — add, edit, enable/disable, reconnect & delete MCP servers from the web settings page, with"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" live status and auto-reconnect."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-mcp-manager"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文 · [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mcp-manager) · [](LICENSE)"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Manage **MCP servers** right from the DeepSeek Harness Web settings page — add, edit, enable/disable"},{"id":"p4s2","text":", reconnect and delete servers at runtime, with live status, automatic reconnect and config-file hot"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"nnect and delete servers at runtime, with live status, automatic reconnect and config-file hot sync."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Web settings UI** — a dedicated "MCP Server Manager" page: server cards with live status, an add"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"/edit form, and two-step delete protection.
- **OAuth 2.0 / RFC 9728 support** — native MCP OAuth 2."},{"id":"p6s3","text":"1 authorization with PKCE, automated metadata discovery, browser-based login flow, token auto-refres"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"h and management.
- **Runtime connections** — servers connect/disconnect on the fly; tools are regis"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"tered globally as `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>` for every session.
- **Live status** — reachability pr"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"obing so a closed server shows **offline** instead of a stale "connected"; a stuck connection times "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"out after 30 s.
- **Auto-reconnect** — a failed initial connect retries with exponential backoff (3 "},{"id":"p6s8","text":"s → 60 s); pressing refresh retries immediately.
- **Enable/disable** — switch a server off to disco"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"nnect and unload its tools; switch it on to reconnect.
- **Config file hot sync** — `$DSH_HOME/mcp-s"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"ervers.json` is watched; external edits take effect within ~1 s, no restart needed.
- **Themes & i18"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"n** — follows DSH light/dark mode (and `--dsw-alias-*` token overrides from appearance plugins); UI "},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ships in **简体中文 / English**."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Screenshot"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### For humans"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Option 1 — from npm (easiest):**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Option 2 — from source:**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. Clone and build:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"2. Make the package resolvable from the profile (pick one):
- Run from the folder that contains the "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"clone (no absolute path needed):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> This installs the package as a plain pnpm dependency (this package has no `dsh.bundle` layer), whi"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ch only makes it resolvable — you still need step 3 to mount the plugin row.
- Or symlink the reposi"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"tory directory itself into the profile's `node_modules` (avoid copying, which would drag in dev `nod"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"e_modules`):
- Windows: `mklink /J "%DSH_HOME%\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-mcp-manager" <path-to-c"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"lone>` — replace `<path-to-clone>` with your local clone path
- macOS/Linux: `ln -s <path-to-clone> "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-mcp-manager`"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Then, whichever option — mount the plugin row** in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Restart `dsh web`** and hard-refresh the browser page (`Ctrl+Shift+R`) so the new `__DSH_BOOT__` l"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"oads, then open **Settings → MCP Server Manager** and add your first server."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> Note: hot reload of `cordis.patch.yml` is disabled on the Web surface (DSH's shared HMR row is off"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"), so configuration changes need a restart."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### For AI agents"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Follow every step, in order:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. **Read this README in full** (especially *Features*, *Known limitations*, and this install sectio"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"n).
2. **Install the package** (npm is preferred): run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-mcp-m"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"anager` in the profile you use (or `npm install dsh-mcp-manager` in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>` a"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"nd use Option 2 below for the file layout).
- **Build/source fallback**: clone this repo, `cd dsh-mc"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"p-manager`, run `npm install --ignore-scripts && npm run build` (produces self-contained `lib/index."},{"id":"p24s6","text":"js` + `lib/client.js`; zero runtime dependencies), then link the folder into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<pr"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ofile>/node_modules/dsh-mcp-manager` (directory junction on Windows, symlink on POSIX).
3. **Mount t"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"he plugin row**: append to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The `/mcp-manager/*` API can start `stdio` servers — i.e. execute arbitrary commands — so it is acce"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ger/*` API can start `stdio` servers — i.e. execute arbitrary commands — so it is access-controlled:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Optional access token.** Set a top-level `token` in `$DSH_HOME/mcp-servers.json`:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Generate one with `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(24).toString('hex'))"`.
When s"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"et, **every** request must carry `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (all endpoints, including `health`)"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"t, **every** request must carry `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (all endpoints, including `health`):"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The settings page shows an "Access token" field — enter it there once (stored locally in the browser"},{"id":"p33s2","text":") and it is sent automatically."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **Network-exposure guard.** When `dsh web` binds to a non-loopback address (`--host 0.0.0.0`) **an"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"d no token is configured**, the manager logs a loud error and **rejects all `/mcp-manager/*` request"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"s** (403) until a token is set and dsh is restarted. Loopback-only + no token stays fully open, matc"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"hing the single-user local posture.
- Token comparison is timing-safe (`crypto.timingSafeEqual`).
- "},{"id":"p34s5","text":"The token is stored in plaintext in `mcp-servers.json` — protect that file (same trust level as the "},{"id":"p34s6","text":"DSH credentials store)."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- **Initial failure retries with backoff, not instantly** — `failOnStartupError` is on, so a failed "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"first connect shows `error` and retries up to every 60 s; once connected, mcp-client's own reconnect"},{"id":"p36s3","text":" handles drops.
- **Reachability probing is HTTP-level** — a GET with a 2.5 s timeout for `streamabl"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"e-http` servers (any HTTP response counts as reachable); `stdio` servers are not probed.
- **Tools o"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"nly** — MCP Resources/Prompts are not bridged (same as the official mcp-client).
- **Auth is token-o"},{"id":"p36s6","text":"nly, loopback-by-default** — `/mcp-manager/*` has no built-in user accounts; use the optional `token"},{"id":"p36s7","text":"` (see *Security*) before exposing `--host 0.0.0.0` (stdio servers execute arbitrary commands).
- **"},{"id":"p36s8","text":"Some MCP servers allow only one active client** (e.g. Godot MCP) — a second connection is rejected u"},{"id":"p36s9","text":"ntil the first is released."}],"truncated":true}
